ingest.title: Document loading
ingest.summary: Text, PDF, DOCX and TXT depending on the demo mode.
items: Here: the fictitious company’s documents are uploaded as text to the server when you pick it.
“Try it with your document”: PDF (with page numbers), DOCX and TXT up to 5 MB and 30 pages.
“Build your own”: text files (TXT, MD or CSV) for your bot.

chunking.title: Chunking
chunking.summary: Each document is split by paragraphs.
items: Paragraphs of up to about 800 characters become one fragment.
Longer paragraphs are split by sentences into blocks of about 500 characters.
Each fragment keeps the document name so it can be cited.

search.title: Keyword search (BM25)
items: Compares the words in your question with each fragment (BM25: word frequency weighted by how rare the word is).
Only the 5 best-scoring fragments are sent to the model.
It is lexical search: use words that appear in the documents. Semantic search (embeddings) is configured in your project.

answer.title: Answers with citations
items: The server always adds three rules for the model: answer only from the fragments, cite the source of each fact and say “I couldn’t find that information in the uploaded documents.” when it is not there.
Each citation [n] opens the exact fragment and the document it came from.

models.title: OpenAI models
models.summary: GPT-4o mini, GPT-4o or GPT-4 Turbo.
items: You pick the model above; the server only accepts these three.
Without an API key, the demo switches to extractive mode: it shows the retrieved fragments with their citation, without writing an answer.

widget.title: Widget for your site
widget.summary: Floating button or iframe with your bot.
items: In “Build your own” you save your bot and copy the code: a script (floating button with the chat) or an iframe.
The embedded chat talks to the same server and shows the citations.

history.title: Conversation history
history.summary: Questions, answers and sources of your bot.
items: In “Build your own” you see your bot’s conversations, how many had a source and how many were not found.
You can export them to CSV or delete them.
